question: ________ was the first web browser developed by the National Centre for Supercomputing Application (NCSA).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mosaic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first web browser developed by the National Center for Supercomputing Applications (NCSA) was Mosaic.**
 
• **Mosaic was released in 1993 **and was one of the first graphical web browsers.
 
• It was developed by** Marc Andreessen and Eric Bina at the National Center for Supercomputing Applications (NCSA) at the University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign.**
 
• Mosaic was a significant improvement over previous web browsers, as it allowed users to view images and other multimedia content on web pages.
 
• Mosaic was also the first web browser to support multiple protocols, such as** HTTP, FTP, and Gopher.**
 
• Mosaic was a popular web browser for several years,** but it was eventually replaced by other browsers, such as Netscape Navigator and Internet Explorer.**
 
• However, Mosaic is still considered to be an important milestone in the history of the web, as it helped to popularize the use of graphical web browsers.
